title: Archive Old Logs
description: Compress log files older than a configurable number of days.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

LOG_DIR="${1:-/var/log}"
DAYS="${DAYS:-7}"
ARCHIVE_DIR="${ARCHIVE_DIR:-$HOME/log-archives}"

mkdir -p "$ARCHIVE_DIR"

mapfile -t FILES < <(find "$LOG_DIR" -type f -name '*.log' -mtime "+$DAYS" -print 2>/dev/null)

if (( ${#FILES[@]} == 0 )); then
    echo "No log files older than $DAYS days found."
    exit 0
fi

ARCHIVE="$ARCHIVE_DIR/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz"

tar -czf "$ARCHIVE" "${FILES[@]}"

echo "Created archive: $ARCHIVE"
